items.answer: Yes! Basil is a good outdoor match for Lagos - it's warm and humid all year.

By FAO ECOCROP's bands (18-27 C), Lagos at 26.4 C is a good outdoor match, and Chang et al. (25-30 C) agree; but Walters & Currey (29-35 C at DLI 19.5) would call it too cool, so the conservative read is below optimal.
Basil is a good outdoor match for Lagos, though one study (Walters & Currey 2019) puts the optimum at 29-35 C, so 26.4 C may be slightly cool for it.
Basil can be grown outdoors in Lagos. Sources disagree on whether 26.4 C is optimal: two say yes, one says it is too cool.
